opening.argument: The presentation first invokes Bitcoin’s exceptional rise and success, then introduces OneCoin as a better, more innovative cryptocurrency. It claims OneCoin is “Already expanding into a worldwide mining network and creating history again in the cryptocurrency industry” and says it “will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market.” These are broad claims of adoption and future success, not neutral market analysis. The pitch is tied to OneCoin through the displayed OneCoin-USA.com website, and the closing frame directs viewers to watch another video. Taken together, the success framing, claims about OneCoin’s market prospects, and calls to continue following the promotion support the position that this is a solicitation for participation in the token.

citations.quote: Bitcoin rises in value with more than a 1000% and becomes one of the most successful and innovative assets of our time.
Already expanding into a worldwide mining network and creating history again in the cryptocurrency industry.
One coin is aiming for the sky and will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market.
